Hello! My name is Macarios

I study psychology,philosophy, science and space I am great at leading helping and solving.

I have some ideas that I want to share with people to think and talk about.And I am looking for people that are experienced in coding and app development.
summary: What if the only thing holding us from exploring planets is the landing sites ? That's why I chose the the Moon and Mars landing sites problem. Because That is a major problem in today's world because astronauts must test their equipment before going to their destination in space and that's why my idea is to build a website that when you type any destination on Mars or The Moon it will tell you the closet place to it on Earth and that's where astrnouts must go to test their equipment. My project will really help NASA find it's future landing sites in future missions in just seconds.
details: My project is 2 websites (One for Mars and Earth and one for the MOON and Earth) that when you enter a destination on Mars/Moon it will automatically tell you the closest place to it on Earth. My project works by storing satellite data into the website and calculating the differences  between (surface imagery + elevation/topography + mineral/thermal data + radar ......etc.) and my website also have live satellite data + it has a feature where the user can put other satellite links to the website and the website can use it to obtain additional data. My project can analyze the differences between two destinations in just seconds + it provides direct access to links for all relevant satellites and data sources it has used to provide this data + all of this information is stored in one website. That's why it will be very helpful for NASA to find its future landing sites. My project will really affect todays world because NASA doesn't have to do researches for months to look for destinations on Earth that matches Mars. Instead have all information in just seconds. I used mainly AI to only develop the website from an idea to a working website. My idea is creative because it solves a major time problem with all of its factors in just seconds. As an individual developer, I considered several key factors, including data accuracy, scientific reliability, terrain characteristics, and the availability of satellite data.
